package.description: Install Builder Extension — author installer packages and put tools on PATH.

en-US.description: Install Builder Extension — author installer packages and put tools on PATH.
en-US.longDescription: Ibex (Install Builder EXtension) scaffolds installer.kdl projects, builds packages via plugins (zip, NSIS, Inno, MSI/MSIX, AppImage), emits CI workflows, and can append a folder to the user PATH (Install in-place). It is not a software catalog installer.
en-US.name: Ibex
